provenance.note: The individual awards announced after the gold medal match. fih.hockey is unreachable from the environment this was recorded in, so the names were taken from the published announcement rather than read from the FIH directly. Every one is then checked against the official FIH team lists this app does hold — nation, position and, for the top scorer, the goal count against our own event ledger — by scripts/test_awards.mjs, which fails the build on any name that does not resolve.
